Anterior, vorder. Citerior, näher zu uns/ citimus. Exterior, auffer/ extimus & extremus. Inferior, und/ infimus. Interior inner/ intimus. Posterior, nachfolgend/ postremus. Propior, näher/ proximus, unde proximior. Superior, ober/ supremus, & summus. Ulterior, ferner/ ultimus, & novissimus, der letst. Prior, vorderer/ primus, der erste. Ocyor, schnäller/ ocyssimus. Potior, besser oder lieber/ potissimus. Habitior, feisster oder besser bey leibe. Deterior, böser.
Adolescens, jung/ adolescentior. Ingens, groß/ ingentior. Infinitus, unendtlich/ infinitior. Satur, gesettiget/ saturior. Senex, alt/ senior. Juvenis, jung/ junior. Dives, reich/ divitior & ditior.
Genus est differentia Nominis secundum sexum.
Quinque: Masculinum, Foemininum, Neutrum, Commune & Omne.

Quæ viro, aut rebus viri specie conceptis cōgruunt, die einem manne / oder dingen unter mannes gestalt verstandē / sich zufügen: ut, Jupiter, der oberste Heidnische Gott. Michael, der Engel also genandt. Mar-

page.notes: Printed glosses in black letter are marked with bl; the German words "oberste" and "Michael"/"Jupiter" are read as roman, with some doubt on "verstandē". The bullet before "Quæ nomina" is kept. Long s is written as s throughout. Printed "s" in "gestalt" and "verstandē" is normalised to s. Several black-letter words (e.g. "lasterzedig", "gesettiget", "feisster") are read with some uncertainty and may need checking against the scan.
